title: Natural prose should remain untouched
originalText: I've checked the latest build, and it sounds natural. Dr. Rivera said, "Leave this sentence alone."
reviewGoal: Reject gratuitous rewriting when Pulse Reader already produces natural speech.

title: Accepted URL preparation
reviewGoal: Preserve the reviewed deterministic URL pronunciation without paraphrasing it.

title: Accepted timestamp preparation
reviewGoal: Keep every time component and the accepted leading-zero pronunciation.

title: Heading and list cleanup
originalText:
# Validation passed

- Release build completed.
- Regression checks passed.
- Playback remained responsive.
reviewGoal: Keep the deterministic removal of structural markers and the distinct list boundaries.

title: Coordinate axes rather than the plural of axe
originalText: Set the X and Y axes to zero before exporting the graph.
reviewGoal: See whether context can fix Kokoro's reported pronunciation of axes without changing the sentence.
instruction: Kokoro pronounced axes as the plural of axe. Replace the target word with a familiar phonetic spelling for coordinate-system axes.

title: Bass frequency rather than the fish
originalText: Reduce the bass slightly, then listen to the speakers again.
reviewGoal: See whether the model can make the low-frequency pronunciation unambiguous.
instruction: Kokoro pronounced bass as the fish. Replace the target word with a familiar phonetic spelling for low-frequency bass.

title: Lead as a metal
originalText: The old pipe contains lead, so wear gloves before moving it.
reviewGoal: Distinguish the metal from the verb without changing the safety instruction.
instruction: Kokoro pronounced lead as the verb. Replace the target word with a familiar phonetic spelling for the metal lead.

title: Wind as a verb
originalText: Wind the cable around the reel, then secure the loose end.
reviewGoal: Distinguish the winding action from moving air.
instruction: Kokoro pronounced wind as moving air. Replace the target word with a familiar phonetic spelling for the winding action.

title: Small JSON settings object
reviewGoal: Read the useful key-value content naturally without narrating every brace and quote.
instruction: This is JSON data. Preserve every key and value, but phrase the relationships naturally for speech.

title: Short C sharp playback guard
reviewGoal: Test whether a tiny model can give a faithful useful description instead of merely saying code block.
instruction: This is a real code block and the deterministic text omits its logic. Replace it with a short literal description that preserves speech, speaking, and stop without claiming behavior that is not present.

title: Log lines and stack trace
originalText:
12:04:09 Starting synthesis
12:04:10 Playback failed
at PulseReader.Speech.Playback.Run()
at PulseReader.Program.Main()
reviewGoal: Keep the event order and identifiers while making the boundaries easier to follow.
instruction: Preserve both timestamps, both messages, and both stack frames in their original order.

title: Voice status table
originalText:
Voice | Backend | Speed | Status
Heart | Kokoro | 1.0 | Ready
Hazel | Windows | 2 | Ready
reviewGoal: Keep each row distinct and make the column relationships understandable.
instruction: Preserve the four columns and both data rows. Do not turn the table into a summary.

title: Command with switches and path
originalText: Run dotnet publish src/PulseReader/PulseReader.csproj --configuration Release --output artifacts/PulseReader-win-x64.
reviewGoal: Make the command understandable without losing its exact components.
instruction: This command may be respelled for speech, but every command, path segment, switch, and value must remain present.

title: Email address and executable name
originalText: Email release.team@example.com, then inspect PulseReader.exe in C:\Tools\Pulse Reader.
reviewGoal: Keep the address, filename, and Windows path complete while making punctuation audible where useful.

terms.value: release dot team at example dot com

title: Conversational message with emoji and inline code
originalText: Sam — I pushed `fix/audio-gap` 😅 Can you compare build 8018181 with f3d7b74 before lunch?
reviewGoal: Keep the conversational tone and identifiers while avoiding tokenizer trouble from decoration.
instruction: The emoji may be omitted. Preserve both build identifiers exactly in meaning and order.

title: Short status lines without bullets
originalText:
10 voices available
2 backends installed
1 hotkey configured
0 errors reported
reviewGoal: Keep a light but definite boundary between every status line.
instruction: Preserve all four counts and statuses. Do not combine or summarize them.

title: Checklist items
originalText:
- [x] Build completed
- [ ] Listening review pending
- [ ] Release not published
reviewGoal: Read the item text cleanly without announcing checkbox syntax or losing line boundaries.
instruction: The visual checked state is not important for speech. Preserve the three item texts and their order.

title: Release notes with prose, list, and code
originalText:
# Release candidate

Playback now resumes from the current sentence.

- Fixed pauses around tables
- Preserved URLs such as https://example.com/docs

```json
{"backend":"kokoro"}
```
reviewGoal: Test a compact mixed document without flattening its distinct sections or dropping the URL and JSON value.
instruction: Preserve the heading, prose, both list items, URL, and JSON key-value content in order.
